public_research_subject: The necessity, literature-derived design, and executed evaluation of a harnessed LLM-agent system for autonomous research that an LLM can operate.
hard_exclusions: internal oracle contracts and validator implementation
OpenResearch internal protocol, file layout, and operational receipts
supervisor instructions, questions, schedules, and status files
instance operations, company names, and application domains
internal branches, commits, and code-diff provenance
harness bottleneck or migration ledger narrative
allowed_implementation_scope: At most one generic sentence may state that the reference implementation uses published agent foundations and a cited research engine, plus the minimum public settings required for experimental reproduction.

applied_changes.change: Removed ARGO branding and replaced it with generic proposed-system, proposed-method, and agent language; retained only literature-derived method concepts.
Reclassified the ledger as internal-only accounting, removed public migration/provenance narrative, and prohibited its use as manuscript claim authority.

chapter_contract.I. Introduction: literature-grounded necessity of a harness beyond a standalone LLM
chapter_contract.III. Proposed Method: literature-derived generic system design and rationale
chapter_contract.IV. Experimental Results: executed evidence only; preregistration if unexecuted

review_rule: Only FULL_PAPER_READ sources support detailed method or result statements. Discovery and abstract records only motivate questions.
